mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PW AS userPw, USER_NAME AS userName, PHONE AS phone, EMAIL AS email, ENABLED AS enabled, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PW AS userPw, USER_NAME AS userName, PHONE AS phone, EMAIL AS email, ENABLED AS enabled, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM USERS ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, ENABLED, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userName}, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO USER_ROLES ( ROLE_ID, USER_ID, ROLE_NAME ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(ROLE_ID), 0) + 1 FROM USER_ROLES), #{userId}, 'ROLE_AGENT' )
